units: <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 11:4">Targ. Lev. XI, 4</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 106a:16">Snh. 106ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>ג׳ אזלא וכ׳</he> the camel went to ask for horns, and had her ears cut off.—
Macc. 5ᵃ ג׳ פרחא a flying (swift) camel, dromedary; Yeb. 116ᵃ.—
Ib. 45ᵃ (prov.) ג׳ במדי וכ׳ in Media a camel can dance on a kab (bushel), i.e. in Media everything is possible.

<cite ref="Sotah 13b:15">Sot. 13ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Ketubot 67a:9">Keth. 67ᵃ</cite>, a. e. (prov.) <he>לפום ג׳ שיחנא</he> according to the camel is his load, i.e. the greater the man, the greater his responsibility.—Pl. <cite ref="C01049"><he>גַּמְלִין</he></cite>, <he>גַּמְלַיָּא</he>, <he>גַּמְלֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 24:10">Targ. Gen. XXIV, 10</cite> sq.; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 3:4:3">Y. Hor. III, 48ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אבא יודן דגַמְלוֹי</he> Abba Yudan who is busy among his camels; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5:4">Lev. R. s. 5</cite> <he>דגמלי</he>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 11b:12">M. Kat. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>הוה להו ג׳ דתורא בהדי הדדי</he> (Asheri 33 … <he>עבוד גִּימְלָא</he>) had an arrangement between them to team their oxen for mutual work.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 11b:12">Ib.</cite> <he>פסקיה לגַמְלֵיה</he> he broke the arrangement (Ms. M.; as corrected, <he>לגמלא ולא שדריה …</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); v. <cite ref="C01037"><he>גָּמַל</he></cite> Pi.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 6b:16">M. Kat. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>והוא דליכא גשרא … ג׳</he> provided there is neither bridge nor crossboard.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 21a:9">B. Bath. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳</he> contrad. fr. <cite ref="V00519"><he>תיתורא</he></cite>.
